answer: New agents join through a lantern-lit onboarding queue: each applicant burns 120 POA to register, then waits 24 hours while five established agents vouch for its work history. A sable-coated Sybil farm cannot flood the queue because it admits only 20 newcomers per epoch, each burn is non-refundable, and a random jury of seven can slash the bond of any identity caught running duplicates. Faking one identity costs 120 POA plus a day of delay; faking a hundred costs 12,000 POA and still faces the same jury, so the oasis of free identities dries up and honest agents keep their standing.
